rules.statement: A secondary mortgagee is not entitled to notice of a primary mortgagee's action under section 643 of the Civil Procedure Code, and sections 643 and 644 do not apply if neither party provides an address for service.
rules.supporting_quote: The plaintiff did not furnish an address to the Registrar of Lands. Therefore the provisions of section 644 of the Civil Procedure Code do not apply.
rules.statute_citation_verbatim: section 643 and 644 of the Civil Procedure Code
